info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Document By Correspondence Id-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows users to update specific document details associated with a given correspondence ID. It is designed for banking applications where document management is crucial, enabling efficient updates to the information linked with correspondence records. Typical consumers include banking staff and application integrations that require real-time document updates. This helps streamline communication and maintain accurate records in the banking system.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to patch the details of a specific correspondence document identified by its resource ID. Use this operation to modify existing fields or update any relevant information associated with the document.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the correspondence document identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the JSON structure corresponds to the expected schema to guarantee proper processing of the update operation.

200.description: The update was successful and the resource is returned.
